head: Drums are three hoops, not a slab.
text: Each drum was one flat-walled ring 60 m wide, which could not hold air. It is now three round-shouldered pressure hoops joined at ring frames, with the same 100 m radius, 60 m length and 0.9 g.

head: Spokes and stay rods.
text: The square elevator beams became round pressurized tubes that end in drum-shaped lobbies. The thin spokes became stay rods with brace rings, like a bicycle wheel.

head: An open drive cluster.
text: The solid thrust plate and the solid shield block are gone. The three chambers sit in lattice cages tied to a keel and push on the shield's backing ring through struts, and the shield is a dished tungsten face with lithium hydride behind it.

head: Radiators built from panels.
text: The hot radiators are segmented plates on carbon frames, fed by coolant headers along a tube spine and held flat by stay rods. The cool ones are white panel wings on booms, braced from king posts.

head: Round tanks and vault.
text: The vault and the six water tanks have domed ends and sit on thrust collars and saddle cradles. The lander propellant plant is a drum instead of a box, and its dewars no longer cut into the hub.

head: Pods and thrusters.
text: Every pod has a blunt heat shield, a back shell, a parachute canister, its own thrusters and yellow release clamps. The aft thruster quads moved out on booms so they fire past the pods instead of at them.
